themes.name: Galaxy
themes.desc: A galaxy far, far away bends around your icons. Pick a side and an era for six different worlds
themes.thumb: url(thumbs/galaxy.webp?v=dfb266849a) center / cover no-repeat, radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 50% at 30% 35%, #3a4a7a 0%, transparent 70%), linear-gradient(160deg, #0b1020 0%, #1a1030 55%, #05060c 100%)

params.label: Side
params.hint: Empire worlds or Rebellion worlds

params.label: Era
params.hint: Which trilogy the world comes from

params.label: Distance from icons
params.hint: How far the bays, clearings, islands and trenches reach around your icons

params.label: Ship traffic
params.hint: How many ships and vehicles move through the scene

params.label: Skirmishes
params.hint: How often blaster fights break out

params.label: Speed
params.hint: How fast everything moves

params.label: Time of day
params.hint: Follow your clock: daylight, dusk and night appear in the scene itself

params.label: Live weather
params.hint: Clouds, rain, snow, fog, wind and storms from your local weather appear in the scene

params.label: Postal code
params.hint: Used only to look up your local weather (sent to Open-Meteo, no account needed)

params.label: Ships react to cursor
params.hint: Ships veer away when your mouse passes over empty desktop

params.label: Double-click to fire
params.hint: Double-click empty desktop to call in fire at that spot

params.label: Quality
params.hint: Ultra renders at full screen resolution with full bloom

params.label: Frame rate
params.hint: 60 fps is smoother and uses more power

themes.name: Meadow
themes.desc: A pen-and-wash meadow where your icons hide in white clouds that cast dark green shadows
themes.thumb: url(thumbs/meadow.webp?v=5d36b1f2d4) center / cover no-repeat, radial-gradient(ellipse 22% 16% at 36% 38%, #fdfeff 60%, #dfe7ef 75%, transparent 78%), radial-gradient(ellipse 22% 16% at 46% 58%, #5f8a3e 70%, transparent 74%), radial-gradient(ellipse 18% 13% at 72% 70%, #fdfeff 60%, #dfe7ef 75%, transparent 78%), radial-gradient(ellipse 18% 13% at 80% 86%, #5f8a3e 70%, transparent 74%), linear-gradient(160deg, #c3d684 0%, #a2c06a 100%)

params.label: Cloud size
params.hint: How far the clouds around your icons spread out

params.label: Clouds over the meadow
params.hint: How many clouds drift over the open meadow

params.label: Drift speed
params.hint: How fast the clouds drift and their puffs change

params.label: Show boy
params.hint: Show or hide the boy together with his kite

params.label: Show kitten
params.hint: The little black kitten resting on the grass

themes.name: Beach
themes.desc: The shoreline curves around your files as waves roll up the sand

params.label: Distance from icons
params.hint: How far the shoreline sits from your icons

params.label: Winding coast
params.hint: How much the shoreline twists and turns

params.label: Clear shallows
params.hint: How wide the see-through water over the sand is

params.label: Shallow sea
params.hint: How far the water fades from turquoise to deep blue

params.label: Coconut palms
params.hint: Number of coastal palms; 0 to hide. Fewer appear if there is not enough sand.

params.label: Seabirds
params.hint: Gulls gliding and circling overhead
